criteria.frozen_before: any ablation run on dev or test

configs.C: B, then cross-encoder rerank of the top-20 fused candidates
configs.D: C with an LLM-rewritten search query (requires live calls; not run offline)
configs.REF: dense top-20 reranked by the cross-encoder (existing reference)

selection_on_dev.advance_rule: a step (B over A, C over B) advances only if dev primary improves by >= 0.02, or MRR@10 improves by >= 0.03 with primary not lower by more than 0.02
selection_on_dev.elimination: a step that does not advance is dropped; later steps are built on the last advancing configuration

criteria.test_disclosure: Retrieval results of A, BM25, hybrid and dense rerank on these 123 test questions were examined in earlier phases; test metrics here are confirmatory only and are not used for selection
criteria.statistics: paired paper-clustered bootstrap, 10,000 reps, seed 7, 95% CI
criteria.latency: per-query retrieval wall time on CPU incl. query encoding, BM25 scoring and reranking
